balun.secondary_center_tap: Open, matching the DNP physical board
balun.construction: Retain the vendor primary-to-secondary differential two-port after grounding primary pin 1. Rebuild a balanced floating-secondary three-terminal model with common-mode reflection +1 and zero differential/common conversion.
balun.reason: The vendor S4P header does not specify CT termination. TB-430 drawing grounds CT; raw S4P secondary common-mode response is low-impedance at low frequency. A floating CT cannot be represented by applying that common-mode response unchanged.
balun.scope: Vendor differential insertion loss, phase and match are retained; individual balun imbalance, CT lead/stub loading and finite primary-ground connection are not represented.

pcb.dielectric: Nominal CAD Dk 4.4 / 4.36, lossless in the first extraction; soldermask omitted
pcb.copper: Finite 35 um outer PEC copper geometry for the complete 24-port model; inner reference planes at facing surfaces, PEC plated barrels
pcb.conductivity_control: Separate matching excitations with 58 MS/m conducting sheets, outer 35 um / inner 15.2 um, check the change in PCB terminal responses. These columns are not mixed into the PEC network.
pcb.baseline_choice: The complete model retains the actual 35 um etched outer-copper cross section. Zero-thickness PEC and conducting-sheet runs remain separate numerical controls. The update is based on geometric fidelity before new RF measurement.
pcb.note: The CAD loss tangent 0.02 is recorded but is not an RF-fitted loss correction.

sma.representation: Uncoupled matched 50-ohm line between connector mating plane and PCB terminal
sma.length_source: Manufacturer overall connector length, used as a declared electrical-path estimate
sma.omitted: Connector launch mismatch and interconnector coupling

rj45.representation: Eight uncoupled 50-ohm single-ended lines, equivalent differential impedance 100 ohms
rj45.source: Declared contact-path estimate from 21.49 mm manufacturer envelope, not a measured contact length
rj45.omitted: Internal compensation and interpair coupling; shell/fixture common-mode coupling

plug.pinout: T568B as declared by user; continuity check remains a bench step
plug.path_source: Approximate front-contact-to-boot-rear axial span in the ruler photo, used as a declared internal wire-path estimate
plug.unused_wires: Open at boot rear, retaining the estimated internal wire length

matched_pair.resistance_source: User DMM photo of loose resistor
matched_pair.geometry_source: Photo axial exterior extent about 11 mm; wire path and axial-resistor parasitics are explicit initial estimates

loopback.geometry_source: Photo axial exterior extent about 4 mm; lead inductance is an initial estimate

sensitivity_ranges.interpretation: Predeclared model variations, not measured tolerances or statistical confidence intervals
